thread:
maria (Docs): Quick sync — I opened a PR to rework the console telemetry quickstart and dashboard recipe. Mainly: rename a couple metric keys, update the tracing integration example, and sweep a broken SDK example link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4528

alisa (Eng): Looking now. which metric keys were renamed?

maria (Docs): cpu_pct -> cpu_util_pct, latency_ms -> p95_latency_ms. I also adjusted the sample dashboard query and added a note about the backend mapping so older presets still render.

nate (Eng-ML): Will this change require any migration on the customer side?

maria (Docs): No forced migration. Backend accepts old keys for presets, but docs should reflect the canonical names going forward. Left an FAQ entry in the PR.

sam (Platform): Can you paste the updated query snippet? I want to sanity-check it against our ingest pipeline.

maria (Docs): Sure — it's short:

```yaml
panel:
  title: P95 latency (app)
  query: sum(rate(requests_total{service="console", env="prod"}[5m])) by (route)
  transform: avg_over_time(p95_latency_ms[5m])
```

sam (Platform): Hmm the transform line looks off — avg_over_time on a p95 metric seems odd. Maybe use increase/irate on request duration buckets?

maria (Docs): Good catch. I swapped that in the next commit to a p95() aggregation for the example. PR updated.

alisa (Eng): Also fixed the Node SDK snippet — import path changed in the new tracing package. Old code gave a 404 on the docs site.

maria (Docs): Yep, the broken link was in the Node example. I replaced the gist with an inline snippet and added a small compatibility note for Go users.

deploy-bot: Preview for PR 4528 is ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood/4528 — please review the rendered quickstart and dashboard page.

nate (Eng-ML): Reviewed preview. Tracing example looks clearer now. Suggest adding a short sentence about sampling rate defaults.

maria (Docs): Done — added a note: "Default sampling is 1% for hosted; set sample_rate in config for higher fidelity."

alisa (Eng): LGTM from SDK perspective. I ran the Node snippet locally. :thumbsup:

sam (Platform): I'll double-check the dashboard queries against ingestion today.

maria (Docs): Thanks all — merging once sam gives a quick signoff or we can merge and follow up with a tiny patch. Tagging @sam for final check. :eyes: :shipit:

sam (Platform): Quick pass done, small tweak pushed to the PR for the aggregation line. Approving now.

maria (Docs): Awesome — merging and will cut a patch if any followups pop up. Thanks! :tada:
